items.title: Smulyan interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: It was Ray Brown and Jeff Hamilton played the first year on drums, and James Moody and Herb Ellis and Urbie Green and Johnny Coles and Sweets Edison and Jerry Dodgion. I mean it was an amazing band. And we went on the road for three months.

ctx.x: Well my teaching, at least that situation now, as long as I make the number of lessons that I have to get in by the end of the semester I can do that. Like I said I’m not full time. I think full time faculty — people who have full time teaching positions, the demands made on them are a lot more, in terms of going to meetings, and so I don’t have those demands on me. I have the freedom to come and go, which is kind of a nice balance. But you know, yeah, I was away a lot. I have a son who is 22 and a daughter who…

going straight from the airport to my son’s baseball game with my suitcase and my baritone. You know? Trying to catch the tail end of his game. And I think that was hard for him. I think it was hard for my kids to be away that much. I mean they told me — my family’s always supported me, they’ve always understood that this is what daddy does, or this is what my husband does, and I see how the very core of the existence as a musician enabled me to be really great and supported in terms of my coming and going, but I…
